Title: Password Reset
Content: You can reset your password from the account settings page.

Title: Change Email
Content: You can change your email address from your profile settings.

Title: Apply Leave
Content: Employees can apply for annual leave using the leave management system.

Title: Salary Information

Content: If you forgot your password, you can reset it using the password recovery option.
